thought.text: The dev server is up and serving QuattroMap on port 8080 (HTTP 200). Let me verify the bundle asset is also served, then stop the server.

reasoning_content:
The dev server is running on localhost:8080 (webpack-dev-server default port — the guide states port 8080, and curl to 8080 returned 200 along with the QuattroMap page).

Wait, I need to double-check which port. The guide says http://localhost:8080/, and curl to port 8080 succeeded. Good.

Let me verify that the bundle.js is also being served, and then confirm that the page is the complete QuattroMap page. After that, I'll stop the dev server.

Let me also check the title and the bundle.

action.command:
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "bundle.js HTTP:%{http_code} size:%{size_download}\n" http://localhost:8080/bundle.js
grep -c "maplibre\|map-count\|QuattroMap" /tmp/page.html
echo "=== stopping dev server ==="
pkill -f "webpack serve" 2>/dev/null; sleep 3
# confirm it is gone
pgrep -af "webpack" || echo "no webpack process running"
